basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: IIT Indore is filling 1 Junior Assistant post through an outsourcing agency. The pay is ₹29,432/- (Skilled), consolidated per month, and the engagement is for 01 year, with an extension based on performance. Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute, knowledge of computer operations including MS Office/Excel, and 02 years of relevant experience in handling Establishment and HR matters. The non-teaching advertisement, Advt. No. IITI/GAD/Outsourced/Rect./07, is dated 9 October 2026, and its last date is 23 October 2026.

age_limit.details: The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for the Junior Assistant post.

qualification.details: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/ Institute. Knowledge of computer operations, including MS Office/ Excel.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/ Institute. Knowledge of computer operations, including MS Office/ Excel. 02 Years of relevant experience in handling Establishment and HR Matters. Experience in Centrally Funded Institutions. The official notification gives the full eligibility conditions for the Junior Assistant post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Assistant will receive ₹29,432/- per month, a consolidated amount in the Skilled category. The engagement is for 01 year, and it may be extended based on performance. The post is filled through an outsourcing agency.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Junior Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Administrative service matters and Labour law compliance of the Institute Contract and Outsourced employees. Processing of salary/OT/daily wage/monthly honorarium claims and other such payments. Providing secretarial and administrative support for meetings and Institutional activities.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Assistant vacancies has IIT Indore advertised?
faq.answer: IIT Indore has advertised 01 Junior Assistant post under Advt. No. IITI/GAD/Outsourced/Rect./07. The post will be filled through an outsourcing agency.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date of the IIT Indore Junior Assistant advertisement?
faq.answer: The last date of the advertisement is 23 October 2026. The advertisement is dated 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Indore Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University/Institute. They also need knowledge of computer operations, including MS Office/Excel.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 02 years of relevant experience in handling Establishment and HR matters. Experience in Centrally Funded Institutions is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IIT Indore Junior Assistant post?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 35 years, counted from the last date of the advertisement, 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the IIT Indore Junior Assistant?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹29,432/- (Skilled), consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIT Indore Junior Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is through an outsourcing agency for 01 year, and it may be extended based on performance.

faq.question: Q8. What will the Junior Assistant do at IIT Indore?
faq.answer: The Junior Assistant will handle service matters and labour law compliance for the Institute's contract and outsourced employees. The work also covers processing salary, OT, daily wage and monthly honorarium claims, and giving secretarial and administrative support for meetings and Institutional activities.
